rappel_detail.pull: Short — the least demanding of the tower rappels, and the one that sets expectations too low for the three above it.
rappel_detail.notes: First rappel off a major gendarme on the ridge crest, on the way up the buttress.
rappel_detail.station: Off the first tower on the ridge.

rappel_detail.pull: About 40 m, so a single 60 m doubled does not reach. Parties either carry a second line, or rappel as far as one rope allows and then build a second station or belay the last stretch of low fifth class down to the notch.
rappel_detail.notes: Continues past another pinnacle; anchors are improvised rather than fixed stations.
rappel_detail.station: Off the second tower into the notch below it.

rappel_detail.pull: About 40 m again — same problem and same two workarounds if you are on a single rope.
rappel_detail.notes: Rockfall risk noted along this ridge; back up marginal-looking anchors where possible.

rappel_detail.pull: Closer to 50 m, the longest of the tower rappels. On one rope this is the one most likely to leave you hanging above the notch.
rappel_detail.notes: Getting off this notch/gendarme is effectively irreversible once ropes are pulled.

Rappel 5 of about 12, off another tower or gendarme on the crest into the notch below it. No individual description of this rappel is published; build the anchor from what the tower offers and expect loose rock.

rappel_detail.pull: Carry a good length of cord. The single-strand anchors left here have been found in poor shape a year later, and have since been rebuilt redundant — assume you will be replacing rather than clipping.
rappel_detail.notes: Off the Pole of Remoteness, the last major tower before the false summit; easier ground then leads toward West Fury's summit.
hazards: Rockfall on this rappel severed a rope on the first ascent. Having a second line in the system is what made that survivable
rappel_detail.station: Off the top of the Pole of Remoteness. The anchor is a large block on the summit of the tower; parties have tested it deliberately before committing to it.
